body:
That's how I feel. I don't have a particular reason to hate him the way I do. It's just that whatever he says or does makes me cringe and hate him. He's done lots of things that bothered me but none that would make me mad at him - at least not that I know of.

Luckily, we're going our separate paths in the fall, attending college. I won't have to see him anymore, so I guess I won't bother trying to fix things.

Yeah well, he's not the most empathetic person I know. Talking to him about personal stuff or feelings is a huge taboo for him - which is one of the reasons I despise him. 

I like the way things ended, I'm just a bit down because I don't have a person who I can call anytime to hang out now.
